'''Herrencreme''' is a German [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] based on [[Cookbook:Custard|custard]] and cream.

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Liter|L]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 packets (88 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) German [[Cookbook:Custard Powder|custard powder]] (e.g. Dr. Oetker)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¼ L [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]]
* Grated [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]] or chocolate [[Cookbook:Sprinkles|sprinkles]]
* [[Cookbook:Rum|Rum]]

==Procedure==

# Combine milk, sugar, salt, and custard powder in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Cook, stirring, over medium heat until it has thickened.
# Place a sheet of [[Cookbook:Cling film|cling film]] on the surface of the pudding to prevent a skin from forming, and let cool completely.
# Transfer the pudding to a bowl. Stir in rum and chocolate to taste.
# [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in the whipped cream.
# Chill in fridge for about 2 hours.
# Serve.
